text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp*... Did I do it? My focus was 
almost completely shot to pieces, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: My legs... they moved properly~! Phew...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Despite various moments of chaos before 
the race, Hishi Miracle managed to pull 
through the Kobe Shimbun Hai splendidly."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing that run... my resolve as a 
Trainer regarding what to do next was set 
in stone."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful run, Hishi Miracle! 
Wouldn't you say you're in full bloom now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aw, it wasn't that big a deal~ The pace 
just worked in my favor—chalk it up to my 
specialty, a little miracle.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
With that miracle power, are you heading 
for the Kikuka Sho next!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well~ I'll have to talk that over with my 
Trainer first~

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S, that was a pretty good run 
for a prep race, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. My breathing has gotten better.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Next is naturally the Kikuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Next up is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: No. I will not run the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, Kris S-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I-is there some kind of problem? Like your 
condition, or the 3,000-meter distance...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
There's no problem at all. Yet from 
today's run... I realized something.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Push harder, give my best. That is how I 
repay the favor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Next is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: It's the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Following Tanino Gimlet's break from 
racing, it was a totally unexpected 
bombshell.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leading Classic-year Umamusume normally 
head toward the Kikuka Sho, the final leg 
of the Triple Crown, in the autumn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bypassing that to run in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) is quite irregular. Being an open 
race against Senior-tier competitors, the 
difficulty is that much higher.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the Kikuka Sho is 3,000m, while 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn) is 2,000m. If she 
can go toe-to-toe with Senior-class 
Umamusume at medium distance...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) could be an option. 
Considering Symboli Kris S's capabilities, 
it seemed like a viable choice.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"T-T-Trainer-san, I have no idea what's 
going on~. My head is a total mess, like a 
ruined okonomiyaki or something~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet-chan pulled ahead, and Kris S-chan 
broke away too... Wh-Wh-Whaaat!?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, this is definitely unexpected, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The balance of power shifted dramatically 
from the spring. The question now is, in 
light of this, how Hishi Miracle will 
decide to act.
choice_data_list: What will you do, Hishi Miracle?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, what do we do... the 
next race? Like, it's up to me to decide?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even if you tell me to be decisive... Me, 
entering the Kikuka Sho...? Eeeeeh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She looks completely taken aback. In 
times like this, the only way forward is 
to push, push, and keep pushing."
choice_data_list: We've put in the work, haven't we!
We've put in the work, haven't we!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I put in the effort, sure... But I don't 
really have the resolve to bet my whole 
life on racing~
choice_data_list: Two powerhouses are absent... which means?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If the two of them are absent, that 
mea~ns...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, that means a prime chance to 
win, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It means going up two places, right? Like 
turning 7th place into 5th..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A dream that failed to blossom. A 
noncommittal attitude. And yet—"
choice_data_list:
I'll leave the decision to you, Hishi 
Miracle!
It's up to you, Hishi Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I chose to believe, leaving it up to her 
own will and momentum. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's the Hishi Miracle who ran through 
that summer, then surely—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... If you're leaving it to me, 
this time I'll—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Should I skip it...? Maybe. It's still 
fine, right? The GⅠ goal is still a ways 
away...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Summer—a dud. Despite overcoming all 
those difficulties, Hishi Miracle remained 
as sluggish as ever..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then there's no other choice. I decided 
to hand over our trump card."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, this piece of paper is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The registration sheet for the Kikuka 
Sho...? And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's already filled out. Are you telling 
me to look this over and think carefully?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, a copy...?
choice_data_list: I already submitted it for you

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, submitted...? Wait, doesn't that 
mean you've already decided~ !?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, why~?
choice_data_list: Because it's better to force it out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course I want to respect her autonomy. 
But if the result is Hishi Miracle being 
miserable, then it's pointless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since I pushed it through forcibly, I had 
no choice but to take responsibility with 
results...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Geez, that's so mean~. Trainer, you ogre, 
you demon, you English teacher~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, you really don't have to 
be my English teacher~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Are you really sure you want to go? Don't 
say I didn't warn you. But if that's what 
you've decided, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Geez, forget it! Fine, I get it! If 
neither Gimlet-chan nor Kris S-chan are 
here—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After pushing and pushing relentlessly, 
she finally got motivated."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A Kikuka Sho with no formidable rivals 
present. This was truly a massive 
opportunity for Hishi Miracle.
